entities.summary: Abby Lea Finkenauer is an American politician who served as the United States Special Envoy for Global Youth Issues within the U.S. Department of State from 2022 to 2025. Finkenauer previously served as the U.S. representative from Iowa's 1st congressional district from 2019 to 2021. She is a member of the Democratic Party. Abby Finkenauer was a political leaders from Sherrill (b. 1988-12-27, Sherrill). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to political systems and geopolitics.
